# Draft:Global Award for Sustainable Development in Cities (Shanghai Award)

----
The Global Award for Sustainable Development in Cities (Shanghai Award) is a global prize announced each year on World Cities Day.The project is led by UN-Habitat and Shanghai Municipality.
The inaugural winners, in 2023, were Brisbane, Australia; Fuzhou, China; George Town, Malaysia; Kampala, Uganda; and Salvador, Brazil.
The 2024 winners were Agadir, Morocco; Thiruvananthapuram, India; Doha, Qatar; Iztapalapa, Mexico; and Melbourne, Australia.
